scientific_question: Does a continuous cost on an engaged unmatched third actor produce a monotone change in the routed-message effect on partner selection, and is the response different under private versus full information?
primary: penalty-dose × routed-communication interaction on target-pair legal rate conditional on physical execution, with strict as a hard-constraint anchor
secondary: team Q, physical execution, conditional Q, engage rate, proposal legality, third-agent neutrality, ignored and unexecuted proposals, pair/site/destination rates
rematching: For rematched training, each sampled world assigns its three private needs through an independent uniform six-way permutation; static uses identity.
settlement: c0–c100 execute a matching pair while multiplying reward by one minus the declared penalty when the third actor is engaged; strict requires a neutral third actor.
observations: PL exposes each actor own need and public layout/owners. FI exposes all three needs and the same public layout; the live channel is otherwise identical.
action_factorization: Two-way intent: neutral=0 or engage=1. If engage, a 16-way proposal chooses site, destination and partner.
pairing: Within each seed, every condition shares initial parameters, world uniforms, batch indices and message uniforms. Live/silent and penalty/strict therefore differ only through their declared factor and resulting updates.
evaluation: Canonical two-alternative-partner worlds on train layouts at six checkpoints and on unseen layouts at the final checkpoint.
claim_boundary: This measures task-level coordination and a protocol-level rule effect. It is not evidence for lexical meaning, grammar, cultural transmission, or human language origin.
development_status: Independent seed block 66901–66908; six penalty/constraint levels crossed with information/schedule/channel before training.

config.action_factorization: intent softmax [neutral, engage] plus proposal softmax [16 site-destination-partner choices]
config.settlement_rules: c0/c25/c50/c75/c100: reciprocal matching pair with a declared cost on an engaged unmatched third; strict: matching pair plus neutral third
config.pairing: same initial parameters, world uniforms, batch indices, message uniforms and rematch assignments within seed
config.evaluation: two-alternative-partner worlds on train layouts at five checkpoints; new layouts at final
config.selection: fixed8 new seeds ×6 constraint levels ×2 information ×2 schedules ×2 channels ×3000 updates; no early stopping
